request.title: Weekly stock count and reorder list
request.initialDescription: We count stock every Friday and work out what to reorder.
request.currentProcess: Paper count sheet, typed into a spreadsheet, reorder list worked out by hand.

specification.problemStatement: Each Friday the shop manager copies stock counts from a paper sheet into a spreadsheet, then works out what to reorder. It takes about two hours and mistakes reach the order.
specification.desiredOutcome: Counts are entered once, in the stockroom, and the reorder list is ready when the last count is in.

in: A reorder list from counts and minimum levels

constraints: Works on the shop's existing phones
Staff can use it without training
assumptions: Minimum levels are already in the spreadsheet

acceptanceCriteria.text: A count for one item can be entered in under 30 seconds
For last week's counts, the reorder list matches the one worked out by hand
A count can be corrected until the list is produced
